notes: 1.50.15: business rule update — the UI-only client-side prefill for a brand-new (never-saved) KNL grade matrix now defaults every untouched cell along the diagonal Bn->Mn (4 mức: B1/M1..B4/M4; 5 mức: B1/M1..B5/M5; N mức: B1/M1..Bn/Mn) instead of a uniform M1, still purely client-side and never written to the database until Admin explicitly clicks Lưu ma trận. Applies uniformly to every empty framework including the 3 known content-gap ones (Thủ kho / Trưởng nhóm Gói quà / Trưởng nhóm Thu mua) — no field exists in the data model to distinguish content-gap frameworks and PHF explicitly chose not to special-case them in code; instead the empty-state warning banner was strengthened to say in explicit terms this is NOT a PHF-approved standard and content-gap frameworks need extra manual review. A bậc added to an ALREADY-SAVED matrix still defaults to M1 (diagonal only applies to a genuinely new/empty matrix, per the rule's own scope). While adding this, also fixed a related correctness gap surfaced by the new test: +Thêm bậc / xóa bậc previously re-rendered via a full loadFoundationVersion() refetch (2 redundant network calls per click) instead of a synchronous local re-render from already-in-memory state, which left a race window where a fast Save right after Add could submit a payload missing the just-added column's requirement cells (stale DOM). Extracted bindGradeMatrixInteractions()/rerenderGradeMatrixLocal() so add/remove/save-loading/save-error all re-render synchronously from foundationState with no refetch; only the initial load, version switch and post-success reload still fetch from the backend.
